children: Luxurious move-in ready home available in a serene master-planned community
, the nation's leading builder of luxury homes, today announced the final opportunity to purchase a new home at

, an exceptional master-planned community in Camas, Washington. The final move-in ready home is now available in the Powell Collection, offering home shoppers the chance to own an exquisite residence in this sought-after location.

The final home, located at Lacamas Hills - Powell Collection, is a stunning single-story home featuring three bedrooms, two bathrooms, and over 1,900 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. Set on a premium home site, this residence backs to a serene greenbelt for added privacy and picturesque views. Priced at $889,000, this home offers modern contemporary architecture, an open-concept kitchen with a large center island, a private primary bedroom suite, and a covered patio for seamless indoor-outdoor living.

"This is the final opportunity for home shoppers to own a new Toll Brothers home at Lacamas Hills," said Mike Grubbe, Division President of Toll Brothers in Oregon and Southwest Washington. "Lacamas Hills offers a rare combination of luxury, tranquility, and convenience, and this move-in ready home is the perfect choice for those looking to enjoy the best of Camas living."

Lacamas Hills is a master-planned community set in the highly desirable Camas area. The community is surrounded by 17 acres of greenbelt and open space, and residents enjoy easy access to Lacamas Lake Park, which offers hiking trails, walking paths, and water activities. Downtown Camas, with its charming boutiques and fine dining, is less than 10 minutes away.
The Lacamas Hills Sales Center is located at 4826 N Adams St, Camas, Washington. For more information, call Toll Brothers at 844-900-8655 or visit TollBrothers.com/Camas.

Toll Brothers, Inc., a Fortune 500 Company, is the nation's leading builder of luxury homes. The Company was founded in 1967 and became a public company in 1986 with common stock listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "TOL." Toll Brothers builds new homes and communities in over 60 markets across the United States, serving first-time, move-up, active-adult, and second-home buyers. The Company also operates its own architectural, engineering, mortgage, title, land development, smart home technology, landscape, and building components manufacturing businesses.

Toll Brothers was named the #1 Most Admired Home Builder in Fortune magazine's 2026 list of the World's Most Admired Companies®, the ninth year the Company has achieved this honor. Toll Brothers has also been named Builder of the Year by Builder magazine and is the first two-time recipient of Builder of the Year from Professional Builder magazine. For more information visit TollBrothers.com.
